children: Spain's gross domestic product grew 0.7% in the second quarter of 2026, above the 0.6% growth in the previous quarter, the country's National Statistics Institute (INE) said on Friday, confirming both the expectations of analysts polled by Reuters and the preliminary data.
On an annual basis, Spain's second-quarter economic output expanded by 2.6%, a slower pace than the 2.7% growth originally estimated.
INE also revised Spain's year-on-year GDP growth for the first quarter of 2026 to 2.6%, down from a previous 2.7%, but kept the quarter-on-quarter growth at 0.6%.
Last week, INE revised the country's 2025 GDP growth rate downward to 2.6% from an initial 2.8%.
